2609.32876.title: Multimodal LLMs Outperform Pathology Foundation Models in Cross-Domain Histological Similarity
2609.32876.paper_summary: State-of-the-art pathology foundation models, trained on millions of histology tiles, can fail to preserve tissue similarity when comparisons cross slide or institution boundaries. We show that general-purpose multimodal LLMs, without being trained as pathology foundation models, consistently outperform these specialized models in cross-domain histological similarity judgments. Using a relative similarity framework that we release as the MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) benchmark, we evaluate 17 models across 6 datasets and find that pathology encoders often rank same-institution, different-disease tiles as more similar than same-disease, different-institution tiles, a clinically dangerous failure mode invisible to standard within-domain evaluations. LLMs appear less susceptible to this failure, likely because they perform semantic visual comparison of morphology and tissue architecture rather than relying on shortcut features tied to acquisition context. Scaling training data does not resolve the problem for pathology encoders, implicating the learning objective rather than data coverage. Our results expose a fundamental robustness gap in current pathology foundation models and establish multimodal LLMs as a viable alternative for cross-institutional retrieval, dataset harmonization, and multi-site quality control. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
2609.32876.paper_summary_zh: 最先進的病理基礎模型，經過數百萬個組織切片的訓練，當比較跨越切片或機構邊界時，可能無法保持組織相似性。我們顯示，通用的多模態 LLM，即使未經過病理基礎模型的訓練，在跨領域的組織相似性判斷中，始終優於這些專門模型。我們使用一個相對相似性框架，並將其釋放為 MOSAIC（跨機構和隊列的模型相似性評估）基準，評估 17 個模型在 6 個數據集上的表現，發現病理編碼器經常將同一機構、不同疾病的切片評為比同一疾病、不同機構的切片更相似，這是一種對標準的域內評估來說是不可見的臨床危險失敗模式。LLMs 似乎對這種失敗的敏感性較低，這可能是因為它們進行形態和組織結構的語義視覺比較，而不是依賴於與獲取上下文相關的捷徑特徵。擴大訓練數據無法解決病理編碼器的問題，這表明問題出在學習目標而非數據覆蓋。我們的結果揭示了當前病理基礎模型中的一個基本穩健性差距，並確立了多模態 LLM 作為跨機構檢索、數據集協調和多地點質量控制的可行替代方案。代碼和數據將在接受後釋放。
